verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a mobile one-time-passcode (TOTP/HOTP) generator, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any agentic or tool-calling capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
